#!/usr/bin/env python3
import socket, time, sys, select

SERIAL = '/tmp/qemu-serial.sock'

class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.s.connect(SERIAL)
        self.s.settimeout(0.5)
        self.buf = b''

    def recv_until(self, marker, timeout=30):
        if isinstance(marker, str):
            marker = marker.encode()
        end = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < end:
            while marker in self.buf:
                idx = self.buf.index(marker) + len(marker)
                out, self.buf = self.buf[:idx], self.buf[idx:]
                return out
            try:
                chunk = self.s.recv(4096)
                if chunk:
                    self.buf += chunk
                else:
                    break
            except socket.timeout:
                continue
        raise TimeoutError(f"Did not see {marker!r}; buffer tail: {self.buf[-300:]!r}")

    def send(self, data):
        if isinstance(data, str):
            data = data.encode()
        self.s.sendall(data)

    def cmd(self, command, prompt='#', timeout=15):
        self.send(command + '\n')
        return self.recv_until(prompt, timeout)

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.s.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
